basis.settings: S58 selection pricing (tools/dsrom_4096_partition_token_options.py / dsrom_fit/price_options.py): cons_v41_rom(58,8,36,bf16=columns,PRODUCT_CLOCK,...,die=DIE_SHRUNK_INTERIM); reproduces AR 390.06 us @1M, 373.05 us @200K
basis.par2: The model has no PAR2 term: per-stage figures are per die of the TP-4 group. PAR2 splits each rank over 2 dies (fixed services incl. indexer replicated on both: dsrom_reticle_fixed_debit_reconciliation_20261002/model-r4.json:329).
basis.stage_cut: cons_stage_plan: equal-BYTE cut (tools/uarch_model.py:3492-3519); non-expert nodes on the layer start stage, experts by byte fraction (_cons_occupancy, 3735-3748)

layer20.what: Layer 20 is the only csa2-1-full layer: compression ratio 1, KV owner, scans_index with index_scan_entries_cap 0 (uncapped), and candidate_source_layer_id (block-max top-2048 for reindex layers 24/28/32/36). configs/models/candidates/deepseek-v4.1-flash.json:433-441, 757, 759; csa2-2-full layers 2/8/14 scan ctx/2 uncapped; reindex layers 24-36 capped at 16384 (:474-594).
layer20.ops: attn.idx.score (kvscan, 262,144 keys/die x 32 heads x 128, FP4) -> idx.topk_local (ot_hdc_tselect, top-512 of 262,144) -> topk_merge (4x512 all-gather) -> topk_final; side branch cand.topk_local (block max /8 + top-2048 of 32,768 blocks). decode_critical_path.py:1103-1135; arch_budget_v41.py:241-245,295
layer20.binding: HBM bandwidth: 262,144 x 68 B = 17.8 MB/die/token over 4 stacks x 0.9 TB/s = 3.6 TB/s -> 4.95 us (compute floor 4,096 cycles = 3.41 us at idx_macs 262,144/cycle). uarch_model.py:352-361; arch_budget_v41.py:137-139
layer20.serial: idx.topk_local is added with stream=False (decode_critical_path.py:276 default; 843-848), so its 4,096-beat ingest (3.41 us) runs AFTER the last score although the docstring (816-819) says the tselect is chased by the scorer. On the 1M critical path layer 20 costs 9.17 us of idx/cand chain (score 5.09 + topk_local 3.58 + merge/final 0.5) vs 0.88 us for a capped reindex layer.
layer20.context_dependence: Linear in context: 1M 4.95+3.41 us, 200K 0.94+0.65 us. The four uncapped scans (L2/8/14/20) account for 17.02 us of the 17.01 us AR difference between 1M (390.06) and 200K (373.05): all of the context sensitivity of the token.

power.note: _cons_cooling (uarch_model.py:3713-3722) takes the busiest of ALL stages incl. head; at S58 that is the head stage (no layer pairs), so the published 189.0/203.6 W is not the hottest layer die. Per die without PAR2; PAR2 halves the dynamic part.

chase.description: Chase idx/cand tselect on the scorer stream (stream=True): ingest overlaps the HBM-bound scan
chase.cost: 0 dies; exact (same position-order stream, same tselect)

cp8.description: Context-parallel L20 index scan over the PAR2 pair (8 dies), position-order 8x512 final merge
cp8.cost: 0 dies if PAR2 partner keeps its indexer+HBM; exact

cp8:2,8,14,20:200.description: cp8 on all four uncapped scans, +200 ns PAR2 crossing per merge

chase+cp8:2,8,14,20:200.description: chase + cp8 on all four scans (+200 ns)

cp16:2,8,14,20:200.description: 16-way: PAR2 pair + next stage pair, +200 ns
cp16:2,8,14,20:200.cost: keys of the scan layer placed on stage s+1 HBM too; exact

time_cut.desc: Re-cut the 40 layers by TIME instead of bytes (or give layer 20 its own stage).
time_cut.finding: Per-layer expert issue is only 0.27 us/die (6 of 384 experts active); the non-expert attention block of a layer is indivisible on its start stage. Layer 20's block is 11.39 us at 1M, so NO cut can bring the stage below 11.39 us (vs 11.57 now, -1.6%). Equal bytes is already ~equal expert count; the imbalance is one indivisible operator, not the cut.
time_cut.single_user: 0 (same work, same 57 hops; isolating L20 onto its own stage adds 1 hop = +0.40 us)
time_cut.throughput: 0 at S58: the head stage (lm_head 12.27 us/die) binds saturation at 80,833 tok/s in every variant
time_cut.dies: +0 (re-cut) / +4 (+8 PAR2) for an isolated stage; the cut moves bytes to the other stages (field area)

replicate.desc: Two copies of the layer-20 stage, users alternate
replicate.throughput: stage 29 interval 11.57 -> 5.79 us; system gain 0 while the head binds; then stages 20/11/2 (7.0-7.5 us) bind -> replicate all four = +16 dies (+32 PAR2) for 1/7.51->1/2.84 us
replicate.dies: +4 per replicated stage (+8 PAR2), ROM masks reused, HBM capacity per user unchanged

dedicated_scan_units.desc: More indexer MACs / tselect lanes on the same die
dedicated_scan_units.finding: No gain on the score: it is HBM-bound (4.95 us bytes vs 3.41 us compute) and the die is at HBM_STACKS_PER_DIE_MAX=4 (arch_budget_v41.py:137). More tselect lanes only shorten the 3.41 us ingest, which chase hides for free. An SRAM key cache needs 17.8 MB/die per user.

head.finding: lm_head [129280,5120] is split 4 ways (decode_critical_path.py:1048) although n_head=8 head dies are provisioned; at 12.37 us it is the saturated bound at S58 for both contexts. Splitting the vocabulary 8 ways (6.2 us) is a prerequisite for any stage-29 throughput gain. Hand-off to the parallelism study.

options_analytical.per_resource_caveat: Stage occupancy sums issue over all units on the die (uarch_model.py:3735-3748). If the indexer HBM reader, tselect, field and SU pipeline different users concurrently, stage 29 interval is max(4.95 idx HBM, 3.85 tselect, 1.73 field) = 4.95 us at 1M, not 11.57.

answer.single_user: The imbalance itself costs single-user latency nothing: a batch-1 token is the sum of the stage windows (sum = AR time exactly) and the layer-20 work is serial wherever it is placed. What costs latency is the scan: the four uncapped index scans are 27.6 us of the 390.06 us 1M token (layer 20 alone 9.17 us, 2.4%); 10.6 us of 373.05 at 200K. 8.8 us of it is a serialised tselect ingest the model does not chase.
answer.best_fix: chase + context-parallel scan over the PAR2 pair on layers 2/8/14/20: AR 390.06 -> 376.28 us (+3.7% tok/s), MTP +8.8% at 1M; +0.35%/+1.7% at 200K; 0 extra dies; class A exact (scores are per key; local top-512s concatenated in position order into one tselect_final, the RTL-verified two-level form). Throughput stays head-bound (80,833 tok/s) until lm_head is split 8 ways; then the layer stage max falls 11.57 -> 7.17 us (cp16: 4.98).
